senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (दण्डयति)
1 To punish, especially by fine.
2 To fine, to amerce.

mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
A stick, a staff.
m. (-ण्डः)
1 Punishment, castigation, amercement, imprisonment or putting to death.
2 A name of YAMA, regent of the dead.
3 An army.
4 A form of array, a line or column of troops.
5 A long measure, a pole of four cubits.
6 A churning stick.
7 A corner, an angle.
8 A horse.
2 A companion or attendant of the sun.
10 A stem or stick of a tree.
11 Subduing, subjecting.
12 Pride, arrogance.
13 A measure of time, a Daṇḍa, (1/60)th part of the day and night, or twenty-four minutes.
14 Standing upright or erect, being like a staff.
15 A son of IKṢVĀKU.
E.
दम to tame, and ड Uṇādi aff. or दण्ड to punish, affix अच्.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं)
1 Relating to a stick or staff.
2 Relating to punishment, &c.
E.
दण्ड a stick, अण् aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A sort of metre, the stanza of which exceeds twenty-seven syllables, and may extend to 200.
f. (-का)
The peninsula of India, from between the Narmadā and Godāvarī rivers to the south, the whole of which, in the days of RĀMA, was a large forest.
E.
दण्ड a staff, &c. and कन् aff.

n. (-ण्यं)
The peninsula, the peninsular forest: see the last.
E.
दण्डक, and अरण्य a wood.

n. (-णं)
Becoming a mendicant or ascetic.
E.
दण्ड the staff carried by the mendicant, and ग्रहण taking.

m. (-घ्नः)
A fighter, one who commits personal violence.
E.
दण्ड a stick, and घ्न who strikes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suppressed by punishment.
E.
दण्ड, and जित conquered.

f. (-क्का)
A kettle drum.
E.
दण्ड a stick, and ढक्का a drum.

f. (-स्री)
A perforated copper vessel, of given capacity, placed in a vessel of water; when filled with water, it sinks, marking a certain portion of time.
E.
दण्ड twenty-four minutes, and ताम्री (q. v.) a copper vessel, &c.

m. (-सः)
A slave, a bondsman, one who has become so as a punishment or for debt.
E.
दण्ड, and दास a slave.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Having a stick or staff.
2 Having authority to punish.
m. (-रः)
1 A name of YAMA.
2 A king.
3 A potter.
4 A mendicant carrying a staff.
E.
दण्ड punishment, a stick, &c. and धर who holds or possesses; also दण्डधार m. (-रः) दण्डधारिन्, &c.

n. (-णं)
1 Punishment.
2 Carrying a staff.
3 Following the order of a mendicant.
E.
दण्ड, and धारण having.

n. (-नं)
Punishing, inflicting punishment.
E.
दण्ड to tame, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A general, a commander-in-chief.
2 A magistrate, a head police officer.
E.
दण्ड a column of troops, and नायक a leader.

f. (-तिः)
Policy, the system of civil and military administration taught by CĀṆAKYA and others.
E.
दण्ड (by) punishment or subjection, नी to get or obtain, and क्तिच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Punishable, deserving punishment.
E.
दण्ड to punish, अनीयर् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Demerit, desert of punishment.
E.
त्व added to to the last; also with तल्, दण्डनीयता.

m. (-लः)
A porter, a warder or doorkeeper.
E.
दण्ड a staff, पा to cherish or bear, affix ड, दण्डपः again, अंशुल for अंशल strong, sturdy.

m. (णिः)
1 YAMA.
2 A staffbearer.
3 One of ŚIVA'S attendants worshipped at Benares.
E.
दण्ड, and पाणि a hand.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Awarding, fining.
E.
दण्ड, and पातिन् causing to alight.

n. (-ष्यं)
1 Assault and battery, a title of jurisprudence.
2 Infliction of cruel punishment, one of the seven vices of kings and rulers.
E.
दण्ड punishment, पारुष्य severity.

m. (-लः)
1 A doorkeeper, a porter.
2 A small kind of fish, (Cyprinus danrica, HAM.) see अर्द्धसफर.
E.
दण्ड a staff, &c. and पाल who cherishes.

m. (-कः)
1 A sort of fish: see the preceding, which it is supposed to resemble.
2 A doorkeeper.
E.
कन् implying likeness, or pleonastic added.

m. (-कः)
A hangman, an executioner.
E.
दण्ड, and पाश a noose, ठक् aff.

n. (-नं)
Inflicting punishment.
E.
दण्ड, and प्रणयन leading.

f. (-तिः)
Fear of punishment.
E.
दण्ड, and भीति fear.

mfn. (भृत्)
1 Having a staff or stick.
2 Inflicting punishment.
m. (-भृत्)
A potter.
E.
दण्ड the stick or handle of his wheel, and भृत् who possesses or works with.

m. (-वः)
1 An ascetic, one who uses a staff.
2 A leader.
E.
दण्ड, and मानव a man.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Punishing, amercing, chastising.
E.
दण्ड to punish, शतृ aff.

f. (-त्रा)
1 Subjection or conquest of a region or quarter.
2 A bridal procession.
3 Procession, moving in state or with attendants.
E.
दण्ड punishment, &c. and यात्रा going.

m. (-मः)
1 A name of YAMA.
2 The saint AGASTYA.
3 A day.
E.
दण्ड punishment, &c. यम to refrain, in the causal form, and अच् aff.

n. (-गं)
Infliction of punishment.
E.
दण्ड, and योग application.

n. (-शं)
A small fine.
E.
दण्ड, and लेश a little.

ind.
Prostrate, falling or lying prostrate.
E.
दण्ड a strick, and वति aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having a stick, carrying a staff.
E.
दण्ड, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-दी)
1 A doorkeeper or a warder.
2 One who threatens another with punishment or castigation.
E.
दण्ड castigation, and वद to speak, to threaten, affix णिनि.

m. (-धिः)
An elephant.
E.
दण्ड a stick, and वालधि a tail.

m. (-सी)
1 A doorkeeper, a warder, a chamberlain.
2 The magistrate or the head of a village.
E.
दण्ड a staff or mace, or punishment, &c. वस to abide, affix णिनि.

m. (-ल्पः)
Appropriate punishment or sentence.
E.
दण्ड, and विकल्प alternative.

f. (-धिः)
Criminal law, mode of punishment.
E.
दण्ड, and विधि rule.

m. (-षः)
Kind or degree of punishment.
E.
दण्ड, and विशेष sort.

m. (-म्भः)
A post or a stake, round which plays the string that works the churning stick.
E.
दण्ड a stick, स्कम्भ to stop, with वि prefixed, and अण् aff.

m. (-स्तः)
1 A staff-bearer.
2 A doorkeeper.
n. (-स्तं)
A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.)
E.
दण्ड, and हस्त the hand.

n. (-नं)
Deceit, fraud, cheating, roguery.

ind.
Single stick, cudgelling, fighting with sticks or staves.
E.
दण्ड a stick, repeated, with आ inserted, and इच् added.

m. (-रः)
1 A carriage, a vehicle.
2 A potter's wheel.
3 A bow or any instrument for casting arrows or darts.
4 An elephant in rut, a furious or intoxicated elephant.
E.
दण्ड a stick, ऋ to go, and अण् aff.

m. (-तः)
Buttermilk.
E.
दण्ड a churning stick, and आहत struck, churned.

m. (-कः)
1 A mace-bearer, &c. one carrying a stick or staff. A fish, (Cyprinus dankena, HAM.)
E.
दण्ड a staff, and ठन् aff.

f. (-का)
1 A kind of necklace.
2 A string.
E.
दण्ड a measure, and इकन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Punished, chastised, sentenced, fined.
E.
दण्ड to punish, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि)
Having a staff or stick.
m. (-ण्डी)
1 A doorkeeper, a warder, a porter, a staff or mace-bearer.
2 A name of YAMA.
3 A man of the fourth order or beggar.
4 A mendicant carrying a staff.
5 A mendicant of a particular order, derived from ŚAṂKARĀCĀRYA.
6 A Jina or Jaina saint.
E.
दण्ड a staff, &c. and इनि aff.

f. (-ला)
A small shrub; also सहदेवा.

mfn. (-ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं)
Punishable, deserving punishment.
E.
दण्ड punishment, and यत् affix implying fitness.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Churning with a straight stick or staff.
E.
दण्डमाथ a churning stick, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Fraudulent, dishonest.
E.
दण्डाजिन fraud, affix ठक्.
